body:
REVIEW-C on 065 is filed. One round. The owner's code was not run. QUESTIONABLE. PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor.

The source numbers reproduce. CR-1457 equation 2.2-14 is 0.33 on the square root when waviness is unknown, and equation 2.2-8 is 0.82 at zero waviness, about 5 percent under 0.86. The ratio 0.33/0.82 is 0.402. Q 0.33 is admissible only with the named limit: not this beryllium face on CR-III. The cap 0.82 is not an installed value. FPL 1810-A is spring steel on resin paper, average facing stress 43,900 psi. NTRS 19730016169, 79.8 to 91.2 ksi, is above a proportional limit of about 35 ksi and is plastic. Neither transfers.

The model arithmetic reproduces. Payload is lift minus mass minus growth on all eight rows. Ramp gamma matches 0.2+0.4*Vc. Handbook-gamma rows match this seat's 064 run to 0 kg. Cap anchors match 063 to 0 kg. Filed ramp concept payloads are -5,926, -7,069, -18,148 and -22,010 kg, factors 1.180, 1.218, 1.161 and 1.198, and every filed TRL 7 payload is negative.

One difference. The optimum sits on BETA times 0.33, BETA 0.6823, so the stress coefficient is 0.225, not equation 2.2-14. Membrane stress is 0.65 to 0.67 of the handbook allowable. Fix, unreviewed: recompute the four ramp rows on equation 2.2-14 before treating those negative cells as the handbook result. FPL 2171 was not opened. T3 remains the measurement that can place Q.
